column1: # Changes a project must make when upgrading Jzy3d, applied by scripts/jzy3d-upgrade.py.
# Columns, separated by tabs :
#   kind     artifact : a Maven dependency groupId:artifactId is renamed, replaced, or removed (target -)
#            class    : a fully qualified class name changed, replaced in Java sources
#            require  : a pom declaring a dependency matching "from" (a glob) must also declare one matching
#                       "to", reported but not applied since the project must choose it
#   from     old groupId:artifactId, or old class name
#   to       new groupId:artifactId, or new class name, or - to remove the dependency
#   since    first Jzy3d version requiring the change
#   note     why, shown in the report
# When the target artifact is already declared in the same pom, the old dependency is removed.
